name: 077.3 — the verbs that act, addressed
author: brodgar
description: Self-checking suite for task 077.3: actionbar, speed, craft and menugrid are reached through a Session and read that character's own bar, selector, recipe window and catalogue; a slot held for one of this addon's own entries reads as that entry and hands the server's content back; and every protected verb in the family keeps the one key it has, refusing by key where none was declared.
